title: Havells Koolmax 70 L Desert Air Cooler for Room| Powerful Air-Delivery| Bacteria Shield Honeycomb Pads Technology| Double Ball Bearing Motor| Multi directional wheels with brakes | Inverter Compatible
description: Experience superior cooling with the Havells Koolmax 70 Air Cooler, a perfect companion for your summer needs. Designed to deliver high-performance cooling, this air cooler is ideal for large spaces. The 70-liter water tank ensures extended cooling sessions without frequent refilling, while the advanced 3-side honeycomb pads with bacteria shield technology maintain hygienic airflow. The double ball bearing motor ensures durability and smooth operation, even during prolonged use. With its bed-height fan position, the cooler provides optimized airflow at a comfortable level. The multi-directional castor wheels with brakes add portability and stability, making it easy to move and secure in any room.
